requirements.requirement: The system must classify lead sponsor into one of: university, hospital, pharma, or unknown based on institution name patterns or known mappings.
The system must normalize funding_source into one of: public, industry, or undisclosed using ClinicalTrials.gov funding_source values.
The system must assign a positive credibility score when sponsor_type is university or hospital AND funding_source is public.
The system must assign a negative credibility score when sponsor_type is unknown AND funding_source is undisclosed.
The system must assign a neutral or moderate score when sponsor_type is pharma AND funding_source is industry.
The system must compute a numeric credibility_score within a bounded range (e.g., 0–100) for every processed trial.
The system must increase credibility_score when one or more collaborators are classified as reputable institutions (university or hospital).
The system must not increase credibility_score when collaborators are unknown or unclassified.
The system must set a transparency_flag to false when funding_source is undisclosed.
The system must set a transparency_flag to true when funding_source is public or industry.
The system must generate a deterministic credibility_score given identical input data.
The system must default sponsor_type to unknown when lead_sponsor data is missing.
The system must default funding_source to undisclosed when funding data is missing.
The system must still compute a credibility_score when both sponsor_type and funding_source are missing by applying fallback rules.
The system must handle multiple collaborators by aggregating their influence without exceeding the maximum score bound.
